title: NFC CardLab
description: An Android NFC reader, writer and card manager. Read card content, write text and website links, create app and system-settings shortcuts, clear compatible tags and save card snapshots locally. Advanced tools support known-key MIFARE Classic operations, APDU scripts and known-key data decryption. Requires Android 8.0 or later; compatibility depends on the phone and card.
descriptionZh: 安卓 NFC 读写与卡片管理工具。支持读取卡片内容、写入文字和网址、创建 App 与系统设置快捷任务、清空兼容标签内容，以及在本地保存卡片快照。高级工具提供已知密钥的 MIFARE Classic 操作、APDU 脚本和已知密钥数据解密。需要 Android 8.0 及以上版本，兼容能力取决于手机和卡片。
